messages:
Riley: Quick heads-up — I ran the weekly docs-curation scan and it flagged a few small things we should triage in the sprint. Summary below.

Riley: scanner output (short): broken link -> /integrations/oauth (404), stale curl example in /api/clients (uses v1), missing owner tag on /guides/rate-limits. Nothing huge but would be good to clear before launch.

docs-bot: auto-scan results uploaded to https://internal.tools/scans/docs/1712349999. 3 findings, severity: low.

Ava: I can take the oauth 404 — I remember we moved provider docs last month. Will look for the new canonical URL and patch.

Samir: I can update the curl example in /api/clients. It's just the base url + header key. Quick sed I used locally:
```
sed -E 's|curl -X POST https://api.example.com/v1|curl -X POST https://api.example.com/v2|g' -i docs/api/clients.md
```
I'll open a tiny PR.

Lina: For the missing owner on rate-limits, does someone own platform infra docs? If not, can we add a placeholder @sys-docs-team and ping product for final custodian?

Riley: @Lina good call. There's no explicit owner on that page. If @sys-docs-team sounds right, add them as provisional owner in frontmatter and add an ISSUE comment so product can reassign.

Ava: Found the oauth redirect — it should point to https://auth.partnercorp.com/docs/oauth2 (moved). I'll update and add a redirect note. Planning to include a one-line changelog in the PR.

Samir: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/412 — replaces v1 -> v2 in client examples, adds test sample. cc @Riley for quick review.

Riley: LGTM, will review in a bit. Small ask: please include a short unit test or snippet under the examples section so our docs smoke test picks it up.

Samir: Added a minimal example test and a one-liner in the PR description.

Lina: I added frontmatter: owner: sys-docs-team and created ISSUE-789 for product to assign. Link in PR comments.

Kai: thumbs up. Also — can we add a short note in the docs checklist for future moves: "when moving provider pages, add 301 redirect + update canonical link in all integration pages"? Saved me time.

Riley: Agree. @Kai can you draft a 2-line checklist item and I’ll fold it into the docs handbook?

Kai: Yep, I'll push a tiny PR to the handbook after lunch.

Ava: PR for oauth fix: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/413 — includes redirect rule and changelog entry.

Riley: Great, thanks everyone. Plan: merge 412 & 413 today, then re-run scan. If any followups pop up, we can batch them into tomorrow's 30-min docs triage. :thumbsup:

Samir: sounds good.

Lina: Thanks — setting a calendar reminder for the follow-up.

docs-bot: scan re-run scheduled for 1712360000. Results will post here when done.
